# `hk config get`

- **How to hail it:** `hk config get <KEY>`
- **Effect:** read-only (looks, never touches)

Fetch up one particular configuration value

Takes any setting name that `hk config dump` shows (for example fail_fast, exclude, or skip_steps), plus jobs, enabled_profiles, and disabled_profiles. Those last two list the watches (profiles) that are called up and stood down.

## Cargo it takes {#arguments}

- **`<KEY>`** — The configuration key to fetch up

## Flags to fly {#flags}

- **`-h --help`** — Print help, for when ye've lost yer bearings

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Tales from the deck {#examples}

Read off a single runtime setting by its underscore-separated name, matey.

```sh
hk config get jobs
hk config get skip_steps
```
